source.title: Tilaya - Wild Blade
source.name: Tilaya
source.description: A Warrior with a massive sword who fights by harnessing the power of plants.

skills.name: Wrath of the Wilds

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, Tilaya loses 70% HP and gains Vine Ward, a shield that blocks up to 120% (HP-based) + 12% (SP-based) damage. Vine War automatically recovers 10% (HP-based) + 1% (SP-based) shield value every second and makes Tilaya unaffected while active. When Vine Ward breaks, it enter a 3s cooldown, after which its shield value is restored to 45% (HP-based). Active. Tilaya swings her greatsword 8 times, hitting enemies within a 2-tile arc in front. Each swing deals 60% (ATK-based) damage tiwce. While casting this skill, Tilaya reduces her damage taken 70%; every time she takes 4 hits, she performs an additional swing, up to 12 swings total. If no enemies are within range, Tilaya charges toward the nearest enemy and continues casting this skill. Tilaya's Haste stat does not affect this skill when used actively.
passive: When a battle starts, Tilaya loses 70% HP and gains Vine Ward, a shield that blocks up to 120% (HP-based) + 12% (SP-based) damage.
Vine War automatically recovers 10% (HP-based) + 1% (SP-based) shield value every second and makes Tilaya unaffected while active.
When Vine Ward breaks, it enter a 3s cooldown, after which its shield value is restored to 45% (HP-based).
active: Tilaya swings her greatsword 8 times, hitting enemies within a 2-tile arc in front.
While casting this skill, Tilaya reduces her damage taken 70%; every time she takes 4 hits, she performs an additional swing, up to 12 swings total.
If no enemies are within range, Tilaya charges toward the nearest enemy and continues casting this skill.
Tilaya's Haste stat does not affect this skill when used actively.

text: Increases each swing hit's damage to 65% (ATK-based) when this skill is used actively.
Increases each swing hit's damage to 70% (ATK-based) when this skill is used actively.
Increases each swing hit's damage to 75% (ATK-based) when this skill is used actively.
Increases each swing hit's damage to 80% (ATK-based) when this skill is used actively.

skills.description_lite: Passive. Tilaya gains Vine Wrd, a shield that gradually recovers its value over time. Active. Tilaya swings her greatsword repeatedly, dealing damage to enemies in front.

skills.name: Mighty Slash

description.raw: Tilaya charges briefly and launches a powerful strike on her target, dealing 220% (ATK-based) damage. If Vine Ward is active, she restores its shield value by 160% + 15% (SP-based) of the damage dealt.
active: Tilaya charges briefly and launches a powerful strike on her target, dealing 220% (ATK-based) damage.
If Vine Ward is active, she restores its shield value by 160% + 15% (SP-based) of the damage dealt.

skills.description_lite: Tilaya launches a powerful strike on her target and restores shield value to Vine Ward.

skills.name: Wildwood Resonance

description.raw: Tilaya's greatsword resonates with nearby plants, causing her attacks to deal extra damage equal to 6% + 1% (SP-based) of her curent shield value for 10s. This extra damage cannot exceed 200% (ATK-based). When Tilaya casts this skill, the duration of the resonance is extended by 3.5s for each ally within 2 tiles.
active: Tilaya's greatsword resonates with nearby plants, causing her attacks to deal extra damage equal to 6% + 1% (SP-based) of her curent shield value for 10s.
When Tilaya casts this skill, the duration of the resonance is extended by 3.5s for each ally within 2 tiles.

text: Increases the extra damage to 7% + 1% (SP-based) of Tilaya's current shield value.
Increases the extra damage to 8% + 1% (SP-based) of Tilaya's current shield value.
Increases the extra damage to 9% + 1% (SP-based) of Tilaya's current shield value.

skills.description_lite: Tilaya's greatsword resonates with nearby plants, causing her attacks to deal extra damage based on her current shield value for a certain duration.

skills.name: Verdant Growth

description.raw: The first time Vine Ward breaks, it instantly recover 120% (HP-based) shield value without triggering its cooldown. For subsequent Vine Ward breaks, the shield value recovered after cooldown is increased to 60% (HP-based).
active: The first time Vine Ward breaks, it instantly recover 120% (HP-based) shield value without triggering its cooldown.
For subsequent Vine Ward breaks, the shield value recovered after cooldown is increased to 60% (HP-based).

text: Increases the shield value recovered after Vine Ward's cooldown to 70% (HP-based).
After Vine Ward remains active for 15s, its bond with nature deepens.
While active, it increases the max HP by 40% and Phys & Magic DEF by 60% for all allies within 2 tiles.
The max HP gained from this effect cannot exceed 80% of Tilaya's initial max HP.
Increases the shield value recovered after Vine Ward's cooldown to 80% (HP-based).

skills.description_lite: After the first Vine Ward break, the shield value recovered after cooldown increases.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Increases Vine Ward's shield value recover to 15% (HP-based) per second while Tilaya casts her Ultimate.
active: Increases Vine Ward's shield value recover to 15% (HP-based) per second while Tilaya casts her Ultimate.

skills.description_lite: Increases Vine Ward's shield recovery speed while Tilaya casts her Ultimate.
